title: Carolina Collection Guest Towel Stand - 16.3-Inch Solid Brass Vanity Top Stand, Allied Brass
body_html:
Keep guest towels right where they’re needed—next to the sink—without taking up drawer space or adding wall-mounted hardware. The Carolina Collection guest towel stand brings traditional style and convenient countertop towel storage to your bathroom vanity.

  • Easy reach at the sink: Two arms keep guest towels, hand towels, and washcloths ready at the vanity.
  • Stable on the countertop: A heavy base helps prevent the stand from tipping during daily use.
  • Protects your surfaces: Felt pad on the bottom helps prevent scratching on countertop surfaces.
  • Coordinated traditional look: Designed to pair with matching Carolina Collection pieces for classic bath accessories and heritage bathroom fixtures.
  • Built to last: Crafted from solid brass with multiple designer finish options available.

Specs

  • Collection: Carolina
  • Material: Solid brass
  • Product dimensions (L x H x W): 16.3 in x 14 in x 5.5 in
  • Box dimensions (L x H x W): 18 in x 8 in x 8 in
  • Shipping weight: 7 lb
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
